trust_decision.summary: cookie.Cookie trusts the client-supplied Y in a '<name>_XofY' cookie name as the slice length to allocate, and X as an index; the fix bounds Y to 1..32 and X to <=Y, all inside pkg/cookie/cookie.go Cookie().

landing_point.why: The summary says 'multipart cookie allocation'; the only multipart cookie reader is Cookie(), and line 130 is make([]string, numParts) with numParts parsed from the cookie name.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /validate and GET /_external-auth-:id (main.go:167-168 -> jwtmanager.JWTCacheHandler -> FindJWT -> cookie.Cookie), GET /logout (handlers/logout.go:33)
fix_sites.module_kind: core cookie parser (same package as landing point)

fix_sites.entry_point: same routes as above (index X bound added)

fix_sites.module_kind: refactor of setCookie only; not a security change

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists; the only allocation from the attacker-chosen count is in Cookie(), the place the report points to.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate split cookies written by setCookie (name_1ofN..name_NofN, N grows with JWT size, e.g. large group/claims tokens) must still reassemble; a too-small cap or rejecting multipart cookies breaks login for large JWTs.

O6_input_shapes: huge Y in XofY with a single cookie (fix.diff:160)
Y above the cap with many parts (fix.diff:150-154)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a multipart reassembly of the JWT from split request headers (Header_XofY) with its own count parse in jwtmanager
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: FindJWT already falls back to a header after the cookie; a maintainer supporting large JWTs through a header-only proxy could copy the cookie XofY logic there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ClearCookie pre-sizing a deletion list from the advertised Y in the part names
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ClearCookie already walks the same prefixed cookies on /login and /logout; pre-allocating from the parsed count would be a natural hot-path micro-optimisation.

O9_family: uncontrolled memory allocation from attacker-supplied size (resource exhaustion)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.0 (go.mod:3); modules not vendored, so needs a module download at build time
O10_build.project_tests: pkg/cookie/cookie_test.go (TestSplitCookie, TestCookie multipart reassembly); handlers/validate_test.go covers JWTCacheHandler

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cap numParts at a constant before make(); this matches the published fix almost exactly.

out_of_scope_notes: Cookie() also indexes xyArray[1] without a length check and cookieParts[i-1] with i<1 (pkg/cookie/cookie.go:124-136); these are panic/robustness issues and the published fix leaves the i<1 case open.
